patch_description: This version combines the stronger global differential-evolution exploration from the inspiration program with the full-layout representation, simplex-safe projection, elite reinjection, and deterministic local polishing used by the current program. It searches only the eight non-anchor points while retaining the three enclosing-triangle vertices, reducing memory traffic and scoring overhead. Differential evolution provides broader structural exploration than single-coordinate annealing, while periodic elite perturbations and batched final refinement improve convergence on the nonsmooth maximin objective.
